name: Graph Laplacian Eigenpairs
problem_statement: Compute selected eigenpairs of the combinatorial or symmetric normalized Laplacian of a nonnegative undirected graph.

normalization: Reject self-loops to avoid ambiguous Laplacian conventions.
Sum parallel edge weights; preserve isolates.

problem_inputs.name: num_eigenpairs
problem_inputs.description: k with 1 <= k <= |V|; sparse implementations may require k < |V|.

problem_inputs.name: laplacian
problem_inputs.description: L = D-A, or L = I_active-D^(-1/2) A D^(-1/2); isolated rows and columns are zero.

problem_inputs.name: selection
problem_inputs.description: Select the k smallest or largest algebraic eigenvalues, including multiplicities.

problem_inputs.name: max_iterations
problem_inputs.description: Positive iteration limit for iterative solvers.

required_outputs.name: eigenvalues
required_outputs.description: Selected real eigenvalues in ascending order.

required_outputs.name: eigenvectors
required_outputs.description: Columns correspond to eigenvalues; rows follow a reported vertex order.

required_outputs.name: converged
required_outputs.description: Whether residual and orthogonality requirements were met.

solution_semantics.objective: Compute selected eigenpairs of the combinatorial or symmetric normalized Laplacian of a nonnegative undirected graph.
solution_semantics.exactness: Floating-point eigenpairs with explicit residual and orthogonality tolerances.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each external vertex ID occurs once; output multiplicities follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No ordering among equally valid solutions is required.

validation_rules: Rebuild the requested Laplacian and check residuals and Q^T Q against the declared tolerance.
Compare subspaces, allowing sign flips and rotations within repeated eigenspaces.
Verify selected eigenvalue order and multiplicity with an independent small dense reference.
Do not treat a partially converged iterative result as converged.
edge_cases: Each connected component contributes a zero eigenvalue.
Reject negative weights and directed inputs.

correctness: Rebuild the requested Laplacian and check residuals and Q^T Q against the declared tolerance.
Compare subspaces, allowing sign flips and rotations within repeated eigenspaces.
Verify selected eigenvalue order and multiplicity with an independent small dense reference.
Do not treat a partially converged iterative result as converged.
